items.title: Russell Brand prison message 'appalling' and being investigated, No 10 says
items.summary: Brand's wife read out comments from the comedian on their podcast in which the convicted rapist said he was "not guilty of the offences I have been jailed for".

items.title: Create more jobs for under-25s by cutting National Insurance, key report urges
items.summary: Some parents are so desperate for their children to find a job that they've offered to pay their wages, one hairdresser has told the BBC.

items.title: Lindsay Clancy to face retrial next year for deaths of her three children
items.summary: The 36-year-old's first trial this year fell apart when a 12-person jury failed to reach a verdict.

items.title: UK lost more than it gained from Brexit, Burnham to say ahead of EU summit
items.summary: The prime minister will say the "Brexit we were given has not worked" in a speech on Monday.

items.title: Landmark Crimea bridge hit as Russia reports biggest Ukrainian drone attack of war
items.summary: Russia said Ukraine had launched over 2,000 drones over the course of a day, while Kyiv came under a record 17 air raid alerts.

items.title: Watch: Street cricket and metro ride as Prince and Princess of Wales visit India
items.summary: The Prince and Princess of Wales are visiting Mumbai for the Earthshot Prize this week, but started their trip with some fun outings.

items.title: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
items.summary: Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands have announced a "return hub" for failed asylum seekers.

items.title: Yellow weather warnings issued for snow as temperatures plummet
items.summary: A spell of colder, wintry weather will grip some northern parts of the UK, bringing a threat of ice and hill snow at times.
